shortDescription: Manages server groups on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the server group. Either I(name) or I(uuid) is required. These options are mutually exclusive.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags assosiated with the server groups. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the server group. Either I(name) or I(uuid) is required. These options are mutually exclusive.

options.name: zone
options.description: Zone slug of the server group (e.g. C(lpg1) or C(rma1)).
